neighbours.label: news-report statements about markets, energy and climate (prices up/down 'at' a level, 'temperature', 'energy giant', 'time is running out')
fire: Brent crude was down $1.80 at $76.40 a barrel in early trading.
Silver rose 2% to settle at $24.10 an ounce on Thursday.
Average sea surface temperature has climbed steadily since the 1980s.
Oil giant Exxon said quarterly output fell for the second time.
Time is running out for negotiators to agree on emission targets.
Copper was up 40 cents at $4.12 a pound after the Chinese data.
Global temperature records point to the warmest decade on record.
Natural gas futures fell 3% to close at $2.65 per million BTU.
quiet: My brother spent $76 on a new pair of boots in the sale.
We paid $24 for dinner and walked home along the river.
The water at the beach felt cold when we arrived in the morning.
Our neighbour said his old car finally broke down again.
We need to leave soon if we want to catch the last bus.
I found four dollars in the pocket of my winter coat.
It was the warmest afternoon we had all week at the cabin.
She bought three plants for the garden at the weekend market.

notes: Card: broad-ish (0.88% of tokens reach 0.1 of max), peak tokens ' is', ' job', ' time', ' temperature', ' at' in commodity reports. Probe: commodity price lines 0.57-0.74, 'Time is' 0.57, temperature/warming 0.44-0.48, unrelated narrative 0.03. The + pole's top is ' that' after reporting verbs in the same register. Near misses are everyday sentences on money and weather in a personal register.
